BiblicalUsage: Sâmêach is the word for blithe or gleeful. It stands in 1 Chronicles 16:31, "…heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice…", and in 1 Kings 1:40, "…people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe sâmêach is worth knowing, because nothing in Scripture is there by accident.
